public_rationale: The claim is about one chart that ChatGPT Pro made. The speaker says an unnamed X user posted it. The chart is not in the evidence packet, and the X post is not identified. The same report (e2) gives $852 billion as OpenAI's most recent valuation. The report was available around May 7, 2026. Neither item shows what the chart contained. So it cannot be checked whether the chart left out the xAI–Anthropic and Broadcom–OpenAI deals or showed outdated valuations. The speaker's own description cannot count as evidence of what the image showed. The claim is unresolved.
limitations: The packet does not contain the ChatGPT Pro chart. The X user and the post are not named.
Both context items come from one secondary news report. Its available_at date is approximate.
The Axios and Techmeme pages returned HTTP 403. A guessed Anthropic URL returned 404. None of them were used.
No evidence item in the packet documents the OpenAI–Broadcom deal.

The cited valuation figure (e2) is for OpenAI. The packet does not give a full set of current valuations to compare with the chart. The contract sets no threshold for how outdated a valuation must be to count as 'very obsolete.'
